fields.backstory:
A cheerful, earnest and family-loving boy who lives in the tranquil Ribeira Village. He was living peacefully with his childhood friends, but on his 15th birthday, the cogs of fate began to turn.

Likes: Moving around, catching animals

uniqueSkills.name: Flamekeeper
uniqueSkills.description: Unit and allies are unaffected by Underworld Flames and take half damage from attacks while in Underworld Flames.

personalSkill.name: Murderous Intent
personalSkill.description: If unit attacks first, grants Crit+5 during combat.

fields.backstory:
An elegant swordsman who’s always seeking to fight powerful opponents to satisfy his thirst. A foreigner who travelled across the seas from the land of “Fódlan”.

Likes: Things he finds “beautiful”, sweets, his little sister

uniqueSkills.name: Bestial Impulse
uniqueSkills.description: After combat, grants Crit+2 until a unit makes a critical.

personalSkill.name: Royal Resolve
personalSkill.description: Unit takes half damage when attacked. Trigger % = 30.

fields.backstory:
The young queen of the Kingdom of Saramis, which serves the Dagdan Empire. Possesses an unwavering resolve to face any obstacle and has the qualities of a queen who guides her people.

Likes: Fighting, the well-being of her people

uniqueSkills.name: Unstoppable Force
uniqueSkills.description: Multiplies damage by 3 when attacking obstacles.

uniqueSkills.name: Direct Hit
uniqueSkills.description: Deals +10 damage when attacking with Blaze Arts. Trigger % = 30.

personalSkill.name: Blindside
personalSkill.description: If unit attacks first, cannot be countered during combat. Trigger % = 5.

fields.backstory:
A highly skilled vihuela player who performs enchanting music. Following a “certain incident” 5 years ago, she started walking a path of vengeance and hatred.

Likes: Memories of her parents, performing music from her homeland, jewels, applause

uniqueSkills.name: Improviso
uniqueSkills.description: After using Blaze Arts during Overblaze, unit can attack.

personalSkill.name: Tactician’s Wit
personalSkill.description: Grants Rng+1 to combat arts usable on allies.

fields.backstory:
Cai’s childhood friend. An avid reader, who has a wide range of knowledge despite being only 15 years old. She lives with her grandfather, who’s a former tactician, and as his granddaughter, she’s inherited his keen talent for strategy.

Likes: Libraries, discussing love, grandfather, board games

uniqueSkills.name: Tactician’s Insight
uniqueSkills.description: After combat, If unit attacked first, inflicts Avo-5 on foe throughout their next combat.

uniqueSkills.name: Tactician’s Insight+
uniqueSkills.description: After combat, If unit attacked first, inflicts Avo-10 on foe throughout their next combat.

personalSkill.name: Dark Calling
personalSkill.description: Inflicts Ddg-5 on adjacent foes.

fields.backstory:
An enigmatic missionary of the Church of Seiros, from the distant land of Fódlan. While rational, he often looks down on others, calling them “beasts”. He and Dietrich share the same hometown, but didn’t know each other.

Likes: Various types of pain, talking to intelligent people

uniqueSkills.name: Dark Secrets
uniqueSkills.description: Extends range of Dark Calling to 2 spaces.

uniqueSkills.name: Dark Secrets+
uniqueSkills.description: Extends range of Dark Calling to 3 spaces.

personalSkill.name: Sage Advice
personalSkill.description: Grants Def+3 to adjacent allies.

fields.backstory:
Theodora’s right hand man; a wise general from the Kingdom of Saramis who continues to serve on the front-lines. In a kingdom where writing is forbidden, he records all of Saramis’s history and wisdom in his memory.

Likes: Memorising knowledge, philosophical debates, reciting poetry

uniqueSkills.name: Additional Intel
uniqueSkills.description: Grants Hit+10 to adjacent allies during their combats. Trigger % = 30.

uniqueSkills.name: Additional Intel+
uniqueSkills.description: Grants Hit+20 to adjacent allies during their combats. Trigger % = 30.

personalSkill.name: Guardian’s Duty
personalSkill.description: Reduces damage to 90% when attacked.

fields.backstory:
A veteran warrior nicknamed the “Demon Bear”. He served Leda’s father for many years and sometimes calls Leda “m’lady” out of habit. He follows Leda on her quest for revenge, but has complicated feelings about it.

Likes: Loyalty, mentoring promising young people, imagining Leda’s happiness

uniqueSkills.name: Retaliatory Blow
uniqueSkills.description: If foe attacks first, multiples damage by 1.3 when attacking. Trigger % = 5.

uniqueSkills.name: Retaliatory Blow+
uniqueSkills.description: If foe attacks first, multiples damage by 1.3 when attacking. Trigger % = 10.

personalSkill.name: Steady Aim
personalSkill.description: Grants Rng+1 when attacking with a bow combat art.

fields.backstory:
A 15 year old boy who grew up with Cai like brothers. Has amazing eyesight, enough to see the stars during the day. His archery skills are outstanding, but his kind and timid nature holds back his full potential.

Likes: Mother’s cooking, Ginji fruit, cloud watching

uniqueSkills.name: Correct for Drift
uniqueSkills.description: If unit’s hit % ≥ 90, grants Hit+10 during combat.

uniqueSkills.name: Correct for Drift+
uniqueSkills.description: If unit’s hit % ≥ 75, grants Hit+20 during combat.

personalSkill.name: Brawn
personalSkill.description: Reduces Wt of unit’s equipment to 80%.

fields.backstory:
A fisherman’s daughter, from a fishing village on the Dagdan coast. Wild at heart, with superhuman strength despite her build. She joined Dietrich after he rescued her from being sacrificed to a sea beast.

Likes: Handsome men, harpooning, fishing gear maintenance

uniqueSkills.name: Throwing Arm
uniqueSkills.description: If throwing a spear, grants Hit+10, Atk+2 during combat.

uniqueSkills.name: Throwing Arm+
uniqueSkills.description: If throwing a spear, grants Hit+20, Atk+4 during combat.

personalSkill.name: Power Arts
personalSkill.description: Grants Atk+3 when attacking with a combat art.

fields.backstory:
A tough general of Saramis, known for his strength and defences; he refers to Queen Theodora as “young lady”.
Like Bonaparte, he served the kingdom since the previous king and has achieved many military feats on the battlefield.
Bad at thinking and remembering names.

Likes: alcohol, fighting, singing, socialising

uniqueSkills.name: All-Out Attack
uniqueSkills.description: Multiplies damage by 1.3 when attacking with a combat art. Trigger % = 30.

uniqueSkills.name: All-Out Attack+
uniqueSkills.description: Multiplies damage by 1.5 when attacking with a combat art. Trigger % = 30.

personalSkill.name: Goddess’s Favor
personalSkill.description: After combat, restores 5 HP to unit.

fields.backstory:
A mysterious bard who appears during Leda’s path of vengeance. Calls himself the “Whimsical Wind.” He’s flirtatious, hitting on every beautiful woman he sees, but also has keen perception and is well-educated.

Likes: Goddess Karla, all women, poetry

uniqueSkills.name: Wind’s Caprice
uniqueSkills.description: Grants one of Avo+1, Avo+5, or Avo+20 during combat.

uniqueSkills.name: Wind’s Caprice+
uniqueSkills.description: Grants one of Avo+1, Avo+5, Avo+20, or Avo+30 during combat.

personalSkill.name: Patch Up
personalSkill.description: After an adjacent ally’s combat, restores a little HP to that ally.

fields.backstory:
A young priestess serving at the Aurora Temple at the upper levels of Dagsion. Kind and caring, she watches over Cai–who’s competing in the gruelling Heroic Games with his childhood friends–like a younger brother, always ready to help him out.

Likes: Taking care of others, family, all types of housework, romance stories

uniqueSkills.name: Pray for Safety
uniqueSkills.description: Grants Ddg+10 to adjacent allies.

uniqueSkills.name: Pray for Safety+
uniqueSkills.description: Grants Ddg+20 to adjacent allies.

personalSkill.name: Veteran’s Mettle
personalSkill.description: Grants Hit+10 during combat against an adjacent foe.

fields.backstory:
An ex-mercenary who came to Dagsion to fund her only daughter’s education. She was once a formidable warrior known as “Mikaela the Ironblood”, her name even reaching Buccar, the “Demon Bear of Baphos”.

Likes: Taking care of others, brewing tasty coffee

uniqueSkills.name: Redblade’s Will
uniqueSkills.description: Grants Atk+3 during combat against an adjacent foe.

uniqueSkills.name: Redblade’s Will+
uniqueSkills.description: Grants Atk+3 during combat against an adjacent foe. Also grants Atk+3 when attacking an adjacent foe (trigger % =30).

personalSkill.name: Racing Attack
personalSkill.description: If unit attacks first, grants Avo+15 during combat.

fields.backstory:
A genius Saraminian knight. Hails from a renowned family; his uncle serves as chancellor, and his father is a great warrior whose name is etched in the kingdom’s history. He’s loyal and capable, but his desire to succeed without relying on his family can cause him to act rashly.

Likes: Gazing at the sky

uniqueSkills.name: Accelerate
uniqueSkills.description: After defeating a foe, grants Spd+1 until the end of the map. (Max +10)

uniqueSkills.name: Accelerate+
uniqueSkills.description: After defeating a foe, grants Spd+2 until the end of the map. (Max +10)

personalSkill.name: Competitive Zeal
personalSkill.description: When equipped with magic, grants Crit +10.

uniqueSkills.name: Ardent Nosferatu
uniqueSkills.description: When using Nosferatu, grants Atk+3, Crit+5 during combat.

uniqueSkills.name: Ardent Nosferatu+
uniqueSkills.description: When using Nosferatu, grants Atk+5, Crit+10 during combat.

personalSkill.name: Safety First
personalSkill.description: If foe cannot counter, grants Hit+10 to unit during combat.

fields.backstory:
A young Saraminian archer. Values money above all else and often lacks manners, even towards her liege, Theodora. Yet her archery skill is undeniable. Her background is slightly complicated; she hails from a renowned family, but her father lost his title after the civil war.

Likes: Gold coins, jewels, older men

uniqueSkills.name: Upper Hand
uniqueSkills.description: If unit’s hit % = 100, grants Atk +3 when attacking.

uniqueSkills.name: Upper Hand+
uniqueSkills.description: If unit’s hit % = 100, grants Atk +5 when attacking.

personalSkill.name: Signs of Growth
personalSkill.description: When unit levels up, gains enhanced basic stat growth.

fields.backstory:
A young, innocent girl who ran away from home to search for her missing mother. While tracking her mother’s whereabouts, she runs into Leda during her path of vengeance. She dresses and speaks like a boy to protect herself from danger.

Likes: Father, mother, sweets

uniqueSkills.name: Warrior’s Blood
uniqueSkills.description: Grants stat increase based on equipped weapon type.

uniqueSkills.name: Warrior’s Blood+
uniqueSkills.description: Grants a large stat increase based on equipped weapon type.

personalSkill.name: Requiem Style
personalSkill.description: Unit makes a follow-up regardless of AS during combat. Trigger % = 5.

fields.backstory:
A gladiator who continues to fight in the Dagsion arena.

Known by the moniker "White-Maned Demon" for his demonic strength. It is said that five years ago, he committed a great sin and was imprisoned in the underground dungeon of the arena.

Likes: Training, salted meat, well-crafted weapons, reading, board games

uniqueSkills.name: Go No Sen
uniqueSkills.description: In enemy’s phase, unit attacks first during combat. Trigger % = 25.

uniqueSkills.name: Sen No Sen
uniqueSkills.description: If unit attacks first, unit’s follow-up occurs before foe’s counter during combat. Trigger % = 25.

personalSkill.name: Swashbuckler’s Luck
personalSkill.description: Grants Lck+3.

fields.backstory:
The leader of the “Vandahl Merchants”, one of Dagda’s top merchant guilds. He seems carefree and elusive, but has big ambitions. Apparently collecting items known as “Drake’s Treasures”.

Likes: Money, adventure, cinnamon

uniqueSkills.name: Cannoning Flair
uniqueSkills.description: When using artillery, grants Hit+30 during combat.

uniqueSkills.name: Swashbuckler’s Luck+
uniqueSkills.description: Grants Lck+5 to unit and all allies.

personalSkill.name: Solid and Sturdy
personalSkill.description: Grants Def+5. Unit is armored. Cannot change class to cavalry or flying.

fields.backstory:
A mysterious girl serving at Credna’s Temple at the upper levels of Dagsion. Always conceals her face behind a distinctive cat mask. Although she’s innocent and treats everyone with kindness, she’s somewhat naïve and oblivious.

Likes: Animals, cleaning, doing laundry, cooking

uniqueSkills.name: Predictive Sense
uniqueSkills.description: If unit attacks first, grants Hit+20 to magic during combat.

personalSkill.name: Celestial Flow
personalSkill.description: Grants Avo+3.

fields.backstory:
A girl in white who fights to save her people. Known as the “Mystical Bride” due to her appearance. Has a cool or perhaps emotionless personality, which can accidentally infuriate others.

Likes: Hexagram divination, round objects, martial-arts training

uniqueSkills.name: Continuum
uniqueSkills.description: When unit avoids an attack, restores 5 HP to unit.

uniqueSkills.name: Continuum+
uniqueSkills.description: When unit avoids an attack, restores 10 HP to unit.

personalSkill.name: Brave Assist
personalSkill.description: Grants Def+3 to adjacent allies.

fields.backstory:
A top-tier martial artist possessing both wisdom and valor who operates as a gladiator in the Dagsion arena.
Having trained in the eastern land of Sai, he boasts an immense wealth of combat experience.

Likes: Tea from Sai, Ferghanan horses, dueling, calligraphy

uniqueSkills.name: Flashing Fang
uniqueSkills.description: Grants Atk+4, Hit+50 when attacking. Trigger % = 20.

uniqueSkills.name: Flashing Fang+
uniqueSkills.description: Grants Atk+7, Hit+100 when attacking. Trigger % = 20.

personalSkill.name: Management Skills
personalSkill.description: Allows storage access to unit and allies within 2 spaces.

fields.backstory:
Manager of the renowned trading company "Vandahl Trading," one of Dagda’s leading merchants. She holds authority second only to the chief executive, Talimun.
She meticulously manages the company's funds and is often seen sternly questioning Talimun’s extravagant spending.

Likes: Poetry, animals, flowers in the shade, counting money

uniqueSkills.name: Seize the Chance
uniqueSkills.description: Multiplies damage by 1.3 when attacking. Trigger % = Lck ÷ 2.

uniqueSkills.name: Seize the Chance+
uniqueSkills.description: Multiplies damage by 1.5 when attacking. Trigger % = Lck ÷ 2.

personalSkill.name: Caretaker
personalSkill.description: Adjacent allies cannot suffer a follow-up during combat. Trigger % = 5.

fields.backstory:
A young man of the combat-skilled Hal-Hari tribe, bearing the tribe's distinctive markings on his arms and upper body.
Though taciturn and aloof, he has sworn lifelong loyalty to Orchel, the priestess of Credne Temple, and follows her devotedly.

Likes: Walking in the forest, foraging medicinal herbs, Orchel

uniqueSkills.name: No Mercy
uniqueSkills.description: Grants Hit/Crit+5 when making a follow-up.

uniqueSkills.name: No Mercy+
uniqueSkills.description: Grants Hit/Crit+10 when making a follow-up.

personalSkill.name: Cooler Heads
personalSkill.description: After using Draw Back, unit can use assist magic.

dietrich.requirement: Answer: Saramis, Da Mina, Grounded Ship

leda.requirement: Answer: Saramis, Da Mina, Grounded Ship

uniqueSkills.name: Watchfulness
uniqueSkills.description: Grants Spd+2 to adjacent allies.

uniqueSkills.name: Watchfulness+
uniqueSkills.description: Grants Spd+4 to adjacent allies.

personalSkill.name: Stage Direction
personalSkill.description: Grants Ddg+10 to allies within 2 spaces during their combats. Trigger % = ally’s Cha ÷ 2.

fields.backstory:
A litterateur working as a playwright at Dagsion. Full of creativity, with an endless desire to incorporate anything that catches her interest into her works. Also an advanced magic user.

Likes: Herself, searching for dramatic subjects, studying people for research, seeing how others act

uniqueSkills.name: Dramatic Effect
uniqueSkills.description: When Stage Direction triggers, grants Hit+10 to target allies.

uniqueSkills.name: Dramatic Effect+
uniqueSkills.description: When Stage Direction triggers, grants Hit/Crit+10 to target allies.

personalSkill.name: Close Call
personalSkill.description: If unit’s HP ≥ 2 and damage would reduce it to 0, leaves unit with 1 HP. Trigger % = Lck.

fields.backstory:
A combat specialist who has made it out from the verge of death countless times. He met Talimun while travelling the land as a mercenary, and was hired to work for the Vandahl Merchant Company. He is addicted to the thrill of the battlefield, constantly chasing that high.

Likes: exchanges of life and death, playing with women

uniqueSkills.name: Devil’s Luck
uniqueSkills.description: After defeating a foe, grants Lck+1 until the end of the map. (Max +10)

uniqueSkills.name: Devil’s Luck+
uniqueSkills.description: After defeating a foe, grants Lck+2 until the end of the map. (Max +10)

personalSkill.name: Spirits’ Voice
personalSkill.description: If foe uses magic, grants Hit/Avo+10 to unit during combat.

fields.backstory:
An eerie woman who serves Credna’s temple like the cat-masked Orchel. She’s a “Vulkan”, member of an elite squadron under the gods’ direct command, and she’s known as “Black-Lace Ninae”. They say she can hear the voices of the spirits.

Likes: Pitiable people, talking to spirits, skygazing

uniqueSkills.name: Spirits’ Guidance
uniqueSkills.description: Grants Spirits’ Voice to adjacent allies.

uniqueSkills.name: Spirits’ Guidance+
uniqueSkills.description: Grants Spirits’ Voice to allies within 2 spaces.

personalSkill.name: Quick Draw
personalSkill.description: If unit attacks first, grants Atk+3 during combat. Trigger % = 50.

fields.backstory:
An energetic young swordsman who travels with Anatolia. Trains every day, aiming to become the strongest. Bad at keeping secrets and frequently leaks information about his hometown. Self-conscious about his shortness.

Likes: Physical activity, justice, fighting, good food, combat training

uniqueSkills.name: Never Stop
uniqueSkills.description: Grants Atk+5 when attacking after Quick Draw. Trigger % = 30.

uniqueSkills.name: Never Stop+
uniqueSkills.description: Grants Atk+5 when attacking after Quick Draw. Trigger % = 50.

personalSkill.name: Heavyweight Class
personalSkill.description: Unit cannot change to cavalry or flying. Grants Bld+5.

fields.backstory:
A hulking gladiator known as the “Butcher.” He’s over 2.5 meters tall and boasts overwhelming strength and a rock-hard body. He often portrays the villain at the Arena and, despite his skills, he’s not very popular.

Likes: Rampaging, food, animals, smoking meat

uniqueSkills.name: Pin Down
uniqueSkills.description: Inflicts Mov-3 on adjacent foes.

uniqueSkills.name: Pin Down+
uniqueSkills.description: Inflicts Mov-5 on adjacent foes.

personalSkill.name: Falcon
personalSkill.description: If unit attacks first, grants AS+3 during combat.

fields.backstory:
The daughter of a distinguished military officer, she works for Vandahl Trading led by Talimun.
Having received an elite education from a young age, she possesses top-tier swordsmanship skills and a refined upbringing.
True to her age, she is keenly interested in matters of romance.

Likes: Writing stories, appreciating art, talking about love and romance

uniqueSkills.name: Perception
uniqueSkills.description: If unit can make a follow-up, grants Avo+10 during combat.

uniqueSkills.name: Perception+
uniqueSkills.description: If unit can make a follow-up, grants Avo+20 during combat.

personalSkill.name: Ready for Battle
personalSkill.description: For the first combat in enemy’s phase, unit attacks first. Trigger % = 50.

fields.backstory:
An eccentric traveler who came from the distant land of Fódlan for the purpose of investigation.
He met the cat-masked priestess Orchel on his journey and has been traveling with her ever since.
He has a meddlesome side.

Likes: The teachings of the Church of Seiros, fishing, his own daughter, diligent people, writing fables, preaching

uniqueSkills.name: Pass Judgement
uniqueSkills.description: When Diadem of Balance triggers, grants Atk+4.

uniqueSkills.name: Pass Judgement+
uniqueSkills.description: When Diadem of Balance triggers, grants Atk+7.

personalSkill.name: One Chance
personalSkill.description: If unit and foe cannot make a follow-up, grants Atk+5 to unit during combat.

fields.backstory:
A young man who accompanies Anatolia, the "Mysterious Bride."
He is rowdy and was something of a troublemaker back in his home village.
He loves women and indiscriminately hits on them, but meets with rejection every time.

Likes: Women (especially Anatolia), machines, good food, fighting

uniqueSkills.name: Full Strength
uniqueSkills.description: Multiplies damage by 1.3 when attacking. Trigger % = Str ÷ 2.

uniqueSkills.name: Full Strength+
uniqueSkills.description: Multiplies damage by 1.5 when attacking. Trigger % = Str ÷ 2.

personalSkill.name: Blink of an Eye
personalSkill.description: After using Swap, grants Def+3 until unit’s next phase.

fields.backstory:
A mysterious gladiator who hides his face behind clown makeup. He constantly behaves like he’s mad, and he’s feared by others as the “Jester from Hell.”

Likes: The White-Maned Demon, seeing fear in his opponents’ faces

uniqueSkills.name: Flickering Edge
uniqueSkills.description: When unit evades an attack, grants Atk+3 during combat.

uniqueSkills.name: Flickering Edge+
uniqueSkills.description: When unit evades an attack, grants Atk+5 during combat.

personalSkill.name: Graceful Light
personalSkill.description: When healing an ally with magic, reduces magic cost to 0. Trigger % = Lck.

fields.backstory:
A beautiful yet somewhat mysterious cleric.
She was found collapsed by the river several years ago and taken in by the temple. She is currently affiliated with Vandahl Trading, led by Talimun.
She loves spicy food so much that it can make even the burliest of men faint.

Likes: Books of poetry, spicy foods, coffee, trustworthy people

uniqueSkills.name: Gift of Faith
uniqueSkills.description: When healing an ally with magic, restores +20 HP. Trigger % = Lck.

uniqueSkills.name: Gift of Faith+
uniqueSkills.description: When healing an ally with magic, restores +30 HP. Trigger % = Lck.

personalSkill.name: Steadfast
personalSkill.description: If unit’s HP ≥ 50%, grants Avo+10 during combat.

fields.backstory:
An energetic girl who serves at Credna Temple.
She follows the cat-masked priestess, Orchel, whom she addresses as "Lady Priest."
While she is stubborn and fiercely competitive, she is terrified of ghosts.

Likes: Reliable people, sweets, her friends

uniqueSkills.name: Peak Form
uniqueSkills.description: If unit’s HP = 100%, grants Atk+3 during combat.

uniqueSkills.name: Peak Form+
uniqueSkills.description: If unit’s HP = 100%, grants Atk+3, Avo+10 during combat.

personalSkill.name: Adaptability
personalSkill.description: After combat, grants Hit+2 until the end of the map. (Max +30)

fields.backstory:
An archer girl who has come to travel alongside Anatolia and the others.
Before arriving in Dagsion, she was a traveling performer in a circus troupe.
Having grown up in an ordinary farming family, she dislikes conflict.

Likes: Growing vegetables, shopping, street performing, cheering crowds

uniqueSkills.name: Halt Advance
uniqueSkills.description: After combat, if unit attacked first, inflicts Spd-2 on foe throughout their next combat.

uniqueSkills.name: Halt Advance+
uniqueSkills.description: After combat, if unit attacked first, inflicts Spd-3 on foe throughout their next combat.

personalSkill.name: Healing Knowledge
personalSkill.description: When healing an ally with magic, restores +10 HP.

fields.backstory:
A priestess serving at the Solel Temple in the upper levels of Dagsion.
She's an extreme glutton, and it seems all her salary goes toward food expenses.
She has a gentle personality, but spent her childhood surrounded by roughnecks.

Likes: Delicious food, the moment when food is served (and soon vanishes)

uniqueSkills.name: Distant Healing
uniqueSkills.description: Grants Rng+1 to healing magic.

uniqueSkills.name: Distant Healing+
uniqueSkills.description: Grants Rng+2 to healing magic.

personalSkill.name: Wheeled Warrior
personalSkill.description: [Cavalry] If unit is a charioteer, grants Hit+20.

fields.backstory:
A one-eyed veteran knight who proudly calls himself a “General”. Once served as a temple centurion, but lost his position due to a scandal many years ago and now lives as a mercenary.

Likes: The Great August’s tactics, up-and-coming young people, lecturing young people, reading

uniqueSkills.name: Chariot Stagger
uniqueSkills.description: If unit is charioteer, grants +1 uses to staggering blows.

uniqueSkills.name: Chariot Stagger+
uniqueSkills.description: If unit is charioteer, grants +2 uses to staggering blows.

personalSkill.name: Silver Maiden
personalSkill.description: Grants Hit/Avo+5 to unit for each adjacent ally.

fields.backstory:
A lovely pegasus knight who serves at Jurah’s Temple at the upper levels of Dagsion. She’s known as the “Silver Maiden” and has many fans. Since she’s from a renowned family, there are also many who envy her privileged lifestyle.

Likes: Her parents, virtuous men, caring for her beloved steed

uniqueSkills.name: Soar
uniqueSkills.description: If unit is on inaccessible terrain, grants AS+3.

uniqueSkills.name: Soar+
uniqueSkills.description: If unit is on inaccessible terrain, grants AS+5.

personalSkill.name: Hatchet Man
personalSkill.description: When equipped with an axe, grants Hit+10.

fields.backstory:
The leader of the "Gaia Brigade," a band of ruthless, villainous bandits.
Upon hearing rumors of the Heroic Games, he traveled to Dagsion with his henchmen.
He possesses a cowardly nature, always targeting the weak first in battle.

Likes: Money, violence, good women, vegetables, drinking with friends

uniqueSkills.name: Vulgar Conduct
uniqueSkills.description: If foe’s HP ≤ 50%, grants Hit+20 during combat.

uniqueSkills.name: Vulgar Conduct+
uniqueSkills.description: If foe’s HP ≤ 50%, grants Hit+20, Atk+3 during combat.

personalSkill.name: Tyranny
personalSkill.description: If foe has a status effect, grants Atk+3, Crit+10 to unit during combat.

fields.backstory:
The former leader of the brutal and infamous Black Bird Pirates, known by the nickname "The Monstrous Bird."
Before visiting Dagsion, he apparently had a falling out with Talimun, the head of Vandahl Trading, and harbors a grudge against him.

Likes: Thievery, the open sea, ships, obedient underlings

uniqueSkills.name: Menace
uniqueSkills.description: Halves foe’s Ddg during combat. Trigger % = 10.

uniqueSkills.name: Menace+
uniqueSkills.description: Halves foe’s Ddg during combat. Trigger % = 20.

personalSkill.name: Expert Counter
personalSkill.description: If foe attacks first, grants Hit+20 to unit during combat.

fields.backstory:
A female warrior who leads the mercenary group known as "Palma Rain."
She originally served a provincial noble of the Kingdom of Arago, but turned to mercenary work after the family fell into ruin several years ago.

Likes: Memories of her spouse, mercenary friends, trying to get rich

uniqueSkills.name: Raging Counter
uniqueSkills.description: If foe attacks first, grants Atk+3 to unit during combat.

uniqueSkills.name: Raging Counter+
uniqueSkills.description: If foe attacks first, grants Atk+3, Crit+10 to unit during combat.

personalSkill.name: Heavy-Bow User
personalSkill.description: When equipped with a bow, grants Str +3.

fields.backstory:
A master archer known as "Inyoni of the Demon Bow" who has become the talk of the town.
She had shown talent for archery since childhood, but recently she has been performing at a completely different level, and her name has rapidly become widely known.

Likes: Her family and hometown, hunting, farm work, bow maintenance

uniqueSkills.name: Pierce
uniqueSkills.description: Grants Atk+2, Crit+5 when attacking with a bow combat art.

uniqueSkills.name: Pierce+
uniqueSkills.description: Grants Atk+4, Crit+10 when attacking with a bow combat art.

personalSkill.name: Hunter’s Snare
personalSkill.description: In enemy’s phase, if foe is damaged, unit attacks first during combat. Trigger % = 30.

fields.backstory:
A boy who speaks in a somewhat otherworldly manner, using the archaic first-person pronoun "we."
He was rescued by the priestess Ultand when he was in trouble and unfamiliar with the ways of Dagsion, and he appears to feel a sense of indebtedness ever since.

Likes: The spirits, the sun, his hometown

uniqueSkills.name: King’s Majesty
uniqueSkills.description: If foe is damaged, grants Atk +2, Crit+5 during combat.

uniqueSkills.name: King’s Majesty+
uniqueSkills.description: If foe is damaged, grants Atk +4, Crit+10 during combat.

personalSkill.name: Har Hali Wisdom
personalSkill.description: If unit is effective against foe, grants Atk+3 during combat.

fields.backstory:
A proud warrior of the "Har Hali tribe," a people who revere strength.
Following the disappearance of their chieftain, this warrior is leading the tribe as a proxy.
It appears he holds the Demon God Balor in special reverence.

Likes: Tradition, honor, great power

uniqueSkills.name: Precision Strike
uniqueSkills.description: If unit is effective against foe, grants Hit+10 during combat.

uniqueSkills.name: Precision Strike+
uniqueSkills.description: If unit is effective against foe, grants Hit+20 during combat.

personalSkill.name: Hot-Headed
personalSkill.description: Grants one of Hit+10, Avo+10 or Crit+10 during combat.

fields.backstory:
A lively and carefree mercenary. Has survived countless battlefields and his friends call him the “Unkillable Guzran”. He’s ignored a lot because he’s always bragging, but he’s genuinely capable.

Likes: Booze, women, interesting people, young greenhorns, boasting

uniqueSkills.name: Top Form
uniqueSkills.description: Changes the effect of Hot-Headed to grant +15.

uniqueSkills.name: Top Form+
uniqueSkills.description: Changes the effect of Hot-Headed to grant +20.

personalSkill.name: Barge Through
personalSkill.description: [Cavalry] Can move through foe’s space. (Cannot move through large-scale foes.)

fields.backstory:
A woman working as a mercenary at Dagsion. Originally from Saramis, she was an exemplary warrior, whose skills were recognised by Bonaventure the Mastermind. After a civil war many years ago, she wandered around Dagda, eventually leading to her current situation.

Likes: Honoring her duties, caring for orniuses, improving her combat abilities, reading

uniqueSkills.name: At a Gallop
uniqueSkills.description: [Cavalry] Applies -1 to movement cost for terrain (cannot be reduced below 1).

uniqueSkills.name: At a Gallop+
uniqueSkills.description: [Cavalry] Applies -2 to movement cost for terrain (cannot be reduced below 1).

personalSkill.name: With My Steed
personalSkill.description: [Cavalry] If unit attacks first, grants Shld+3, Ddg+30 during combat.

fields.backstory:
A high-spirited young man who makes a living as a mercenary in Dagsion.
He once served as a knight in the Kingdom of Arago to protect the people's happiness, but he fled Arago out of disgust for the king's self-righteous actions.

Likes: Chivalry, self-discipline, his beloved horse Rocinan

uniqueSkills.name: Mounted Push
uniqueSkills.description: [Cavalry] If unit attacks first, grants Hit+10 during combat.

uniqueSkills.name: Mounted Push+
uniqueSkills.description: [Cavalry] If unit attacks first, grants Hit+10, Atk+3 during combat.

personalSkill.name: Punishing Squall
personalSkill.description: If AS ≥ foe’s AS+3, grants Hit+20 during combat.

fields.backstory:
A proud knight searching for a well-paying employer in Dagsion.
She once served a certain noble, but lost everything due to an incident five years ago.
Though her life lacks financial leeway, she behaves in a way that doesn't let it show.

Likes: Sterling wares, sterling people, sterling meals

uniqueSkills.name: Wind My Friend
uniqueSkills.description: If AS ≥ foe’s AS+5, grants Atk+3 during combat.

uniqueSkills.name: Wind My Friend+
uniqueSkills.description: If AS ≥ foe’s AS+5, grants Atk+3, and if AS ≥ foe’s AS+8, grants Avo+20 during combat.

personalSkill.name: Warrior’s Clarity
personalSkill.description: After combat, grants Avo+3 until unit’s next phase.

fields.backstory:
A female gladiator who takes pride in her finely honed physique.
Born into a warlike tribe, she grew weary of rural life and the men of her village, leading her to travel to the Imperial Capital of Dagsion, a place she had long dreamed of visiting since childhood.

Likes: The city and its people, brawling

uniqueSkills.name: Attuned
uniqueSkills.description: When Warrior’s Clarity triggers, grants Avo+10 until unit’s next phase. Trigger % = 10.

uniqueSkills.name: Attuned+
uniqueSkills.description: When Warrior’s Clarity triggers, grants Avo+10 until unit’s next phase. Trigger % = 20.

personalSkill.name: Monkly Havoc
personalSkill.description: After defeating a foe, recovers HP equal to max HP. Trigger % = Lck ÷ 2.

fields.backstory:
A wayward monk who wanders from land to land.
He once served a temple but became a wanderer over a decade ago & is currently passing through Dagsion on his travels.
It is said that in his youth, he journeyed as far as the eastern land of Sai.

Likes: Alcohol, tales of old, distant journeys, saving the weak

uniqueSkills.name: Robust Health
uniqueSkills.description: Grants Shld+3 when attacked. Trigger % = unit’s remaining HP.

uniqueSkills.name: Robust Health+
uniqueSkills.description: Grants Shld+5 when attacked. Trigger % = unit’s remaining HP.

personalSkill.name: Hellbent Axe
personalSkill.description: When equipped with an axe, grants Str+3.

fields.backstory:
A notorious thug who roams Dagsion.
He had a bad reputation since childhood, spending his days in jail for violent incidents.
He aims to win the Heroic Games in order to become the ruler of the city.

Likes: Booze, women, fighting, being strong

uniqueSkills.name: Fear Nothing
uniqueSkills.description: If unit attacks first, grants Atk+3 at cost of Avo-30 to unit during combat.

uniqueSkills.name: Fear Nothing+
uniqueSkills.description: If unit attacks first, grants Atk+6 at cost of Avo-30 to unit during combat.

personalSkill.name: Crimson Magic
personalSkill.description: Increase Hit for magic attacks

fields.backstory:
A woman who assisted in the birth of the "Savior", guiding them to the Goddess of Fate Fortuna in the "Forbidden Lands." She is aware of the great sin she committed in the past and is determined to fight, even at the cost of her own life. All to atone for her actions.

Likes: Memories of Happier times

A reliable old warrior who joined the Savior Army after receiving contact from the person who prepared Eshmel's body.
She has known the kings of Saramis throughout history and was called "Grandma" by Theodora when she was a child.

Likes: Her comrades, abundant nature, weapon maintenance

A true hero born to shed light upon the world. Similar to the Herald of the Pale Raven mentioned in a poem long ago.

Travels to the past with Fortuna, Goddess of Fate, at the behest of the progenitor god Sothis to gather allies and defeat the demon god Balor.

Likes: Ambitious people, people of great talent, small and unnamed flowers

Interests: Playing board games

routes.name: Cai
routes.title: Ribeira Winds
routes.description: Cai joins the Heroic Games in order to save his father

routes.name: Dietrich
routes.title: House Lamine
routes.description: Dietrich journeys to Dagda to face the strongest warriors

routes.name: Theodora
routes.title: Megaira's Beacon
routes.description: Theodora sets out to establish herself as Queen of Saramis

routes.name: Leda
routes.title: Rose Tempest
routes.description: Leda seeks revenge for the death of her father

npcs.name: Solel

npcs.description:
The Sunbearer, a pillar of the Dagdan Pantheon. Acting as the proxy for “Dagda the Great”, who has fallen into a deep slumber, he rules over the empire as the “Divine Sovereign”.

npcs.description:
A beautiful woman who hides half her face behind a veil. Seems to love watching fierce battles and is eagerly spectating the Heroic Games next to Divine Sovereign Solel. Always keeps her plush doll, Babbu, close at hand.

Likes: Blood, rare flowers
